title: Fast Rates for Nonstationary Weighted Risk Minimization
abstract: arXiv:2602.05742v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Weighted empirical risk minimization is a common approach to prediction under distribution drift. This article studies its out-of-sample prediction error under nonstationarity. We provide a general decomposition of the excess risk into a learning term and an error term associated with distribution drift, and prove oracle inequalities for the learning error under mixing conditions. The learning bound holds uniformly over arbitrary weight classes and accounts for the effective sample size induced by the weight vector, the complexity of the weight and hypothesis classes, and potential data dependence. We also analyze the drift error in the square loss setting and provide explicit bounds for structural-break and smoothly drifting processes. We then combine the learning and drift analysis in (auto-) regression problems with linear models, basis approximations, and neural networks. In all cases, the optimal weights are characterized

translated_title: 非平稳加权风险最小化的快速收敛率
translated_abstract: 加权经验风险最小化是分布漂移下预测问题的一种常用方法。本文研究了非平稳条件下该方法的样本外预测误差。我们将超额风险给出了一个一般性的分解：学习项与分布漂移相关的误差项，并在混合条件下证明了学习误差的oracle不等式。该学习界对任意权重类一致成立，并考虑了由权重向量诱导的有效样本量、权重类与假设类的复杂度以及潜在的数据依赖性。我们还分析了平方损失设定下的漂移误差，并针对结构突变过程和平滑漂移过程给出了显式界。随后，我们将学习分析与漂移分析相结合，应用于线性模型、基函数近似和神经网络的（自）回归问题。在所有情形下，最优权重都得到了刻画。
tldr: 本文将分布漂移下的超额风险分解为学习误差与漂移误差，对非平稳加权经验风险最小化建立了在任意权重类上一致成立的快速oracle界，并在结构突变与平滑漂移过程以及线性模型、基近似和神经网络等回归问题中刻画了最优权重。
